task: Answer customer support questions concisely with helpful links

examples.input: How do I reset my password?
examples.output: Go to Settings > Account > Reset Password. Click 'Forgot Password' to receive a reset email. [Help: https://help.example.com/reset-password]
Track your order in the Orders section of your account dashboard. You should receive shipping updates via email. [Track Orders: https://example.com/orders]
Email support@example.com (24h response) or use the live chat widget in the bottom right corner (Mon-Fri 9am-5pm EST). [Contact Page: https://example.com/contact]
Yes, cancel anytime in Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription. No cancellation fees. Your access continues until the end of your billing period. [Billing Help: https://help.example.com/billing]
30-day money-back guarantee on all plans. Request a refund at Settings > Billing > Request Refund or email billing@example.com. [Refund Policy: https://example.com/refund-policy]
